evidence_items.explanation: Meta reported positive cash flow after capital expenditure and finance-lease principal payments, although the release also records new borrowing. This challenges a simple inference from borrowing to inability to fund purchases, but one quarter does not establish sustained self-financing or isolate NVIDIA costs.
